prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished opaque scenic background for the Split daily beer game, 1024 by 1536 portrait, full bleed.
Primary request: a new Halloween setting called Lantern maze. Richly painted editorial travel postcard, hand-painted gouache with fine colored-pencil detail, tactile weathered wood, atmospheric believable perspective, warmly spooky without gore. Seated eye level looking toward a tall autumn corn maze on Halloween night under a harvest moon. A rustic timber entrance arch and crooked rows of dry golden corn, hanging amber lanterns, unmistakably carved glowing jack-o-lanterns at left and right, tiny distant adult friends entering the maze at the far right. Plum-blue night sky, cool moonlit corn tips, pools of warm orange light, distant old red barn off to the left. Visually distinct from a porch, crypt, pub or carnival. Central background above the table has an inviting receding path, with the main decorations toward the outer sides.
Composition: broad, completely EMPTY weathered wooden picnic tabletop spans the FULL width of the foreground from a clean near-horizontal rear edge at exactly 60 percent image height down to the bottom edge. Lower 40 percent must be uninterrupted bare table wood. Keep central x30-70 percent visually calm and clear for a separate LIVE game glass drawn later.
Constraints: scenery ONLY. Do not draw any foreground drinking vessel, cup, glass, bottle, can, beer or drink. No props anywhere on the foreground table. No close-up people. No readable text, logo, signage lettering, UI, watermarks, border, target or scoring lines. No gore, no children. Opaque image.
